title: Fort GBUS counter-drone equipment health status
note: Draft 1. Entirely fictional. Times are local (Eastern), same format as events.csv. Equipment IDs match inputs/site.md and events.csv.
baseline: All equipment is OPERATIONAL unless an entry below covers that equipment at that time.

status_values.degraded: Usable, but with lower confidence or reduced ability. See 'effect'.
status_values.down: Not available. Do not use its data; do not recommend it.
status_values.unknown: Lost communication with it. Treat with caution; do not rely on it.
